Before clocks became commonplace, in the last couple of hundred years, there was no such thing as "being late".

If you said "I'll come over in the morning", you just went over in the morning, you arrived when you arrived. And for thousands of years of human history that was how time worked.

The entire concept that we're supposed to arrive a destination within a few minutes, or a few hundred seconds of a specific moment in time is a really bizarre cultural norm that we've only developed since we invented clocks.

If anything, the worst you could say about people who are often late, is that they're not well adjusted to this strange artificial measurement of time we all started using.
